The Locus local tunnel uses code from LocalDevVPN by jkcoxson and contributors,
based on StosVPN by Stossy11 and the SideStore Team.

Copyright (c) 2025 SideStore Team.
LocalDevVPN source: https://github.com/jkcoxson/LocalDevVPN/tree/17740a2dfb11cd19a55575aff9aecc74213a3b10
StosVPN source: https://github.com/SideStore/StosVPN
License: see LocalDevVPN-LICENSE.txt.

The embedded extension adapts TunnelProv/PacketTunnelProvider.swift for a
single peer address configured by Locus. It uses LocalDevVPN's on-device
IPv4 reflection and does not require an external tunnel server.
